text:
```yaml
name: Claude Code Review – Comments & Docs

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
    branches: [main]

concurrency:
  group: claude-review-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  claude-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run Claude Code Review
        id: claude
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
        with:
          # Prompt to guide Claude on what to review
          prompt: |
            You are an expert code reviewer. Review the changes in this pull request for consistency of code comments and documentation.
            - Ensure @file documentation is present across popup helpers, entry points, models, search strategies, and views, matching legacy detail.
            - Highlight scoring pipeline steps so future tuning keeps parity with historical behaviour notes.
            Provide a concise summary of issues and suggestions. If no issues, say "All good."
          max_turns: 3
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}

      - name: Comment on PR
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          message: ${{ steps.claude.outputs.conclusion }}
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          pr-number: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          comment-tag: claude-review
          mode: replace
          create-if-not-exists: true
```
